title: automation clone: a clone refused 400 for an invalid name has already installed the source package's empty .custom pair
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract), reach: `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone`, measured twice.
Business reason: a refused write should change nothing. Today an admin who tries to copy a packaged flow under an illegal name gets 400 and, as a side effect, a newly installed empty `BASE.custom` package that shows up in the package list and Studio. Low impact (the pair is the one Studio's New would ensure anyway, and it is empty), but it breaks the "a refusal leaves no state" rule the item and the domain both state.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the `domain:server` lane, `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`. QA suggestion only: `area:automation`, p3.
Duplicate search: `resolveCloneTarget` → 0 hits; `clone custom package invalid name` → 112 hits, all QA run records or #28410 (closed, the override write gate), none about this.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. Fresh boot with an empty file DB, sign in admin. `GET /api/v1/packages` lists no `com.example.showcase.custom`.
2. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert/clone {"name":"Bad-Name!","label":"Illegal"}` → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED "Invalid flow definition: name: … must match pattern /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/".
3. `GET /api/v1/packages` → `com.example.showcase.custom` is now installed.

Expected: nothing installed. Actual: an installed, empty pair package. Reproduced 2 times (decisive on a fresh DB, before and after).

## Mechanism (suspected)
The clone arm in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` calls `resolveCloneTarget` (which ensures `BASE.custom`) before `registerAndSaveFlow` runs the FlowSchema name check. Validating the clone body before ensuring the target would close it.

QA-source: #29002 · automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract · observed beside the clauses
